verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability is moving many codes at once: a community report says all saved codes can be exported into one QR code for re-import, and the docs say codes sync automatically to a new device on sign-in. Everyday management actions like edit, delete and reorder are documented only one code at a time. missing for 10: general bulk actions (multi-select edit/delete/organize), any programmatic or scripted bulk interface, first-party docs explicitly describing a multi-code export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Google Authenticator has a feature to allow export of all saved codes into one QR code for re-import into Google Authenticator running on another device.
When you sign in to your Google Account within Google Authenticator on a new device, your codes are automatically synced to this device.
